title: Angerfang Encampment

[[Image:Angerfang Encampment.jpg|thumb|Angerfang Encampment]]
The '''Angerfang Encampment''', located in the southern [[Wetlands]], is home to a group of orcs which form the remnants of the [[Dragonmaw Clan]]. After the [[Second War]], the clan fled to the mountains to escape from the wrath of their former red dragon pets and established the encampment as their new base of operations. Their current plan is to use the encampment as a rallying point to attack [[Menethil Harbor]]. 

==Characters and Items of Interest==
*The current leader of the Dragonmaw Clan is [[Nek'rosh Skullcrusher]], son of [[Nekros Skullcrusher]] who captured [[Alexstrasza]] in order to provide dragon mounts for the [[Horde]] during the Second War. Alliance adventurers will be sent for Nek'rosh's head by [[Captain Stoutfist]] in the quest {{questlong|Alliance|31|Nek'rosh's Gambit|465}}.
* The Dragonmaw Orcs are known for their very strong bones. [[Velora Nitely]] will send Horde [[Warrior]]s after their shinbones to create [[Brutal Legguards]] in the quest {{questlong|Horde|30|Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards|1841}}.
* Dragonmaw warlocks are known to use Rods of Channeling, required by [[warlock]] players in the quest {{questlong|Neutral|30|Tome of the Cabal|1804}}.
